name: TinyUSB Generic Gamepad (RP2040/ESP32)
notes: 148-byte descriptor. Source: TinyUSB hid_device example (hid_gamepad_report_desc). RP2040/ESP32/STM32 default gamepad: 4x 8-bit axes (2 sticks), 3x 10-bit axes (triggers/sim), 2 hat switches, 16 buttons. Very widely used in DIY firmware.

layout.note: TinyUSB stack reference gamepad descriptor (the test device, not a physical product). The descriptor shape is the canonical hid_gamepad_report_t from the TinyUSB library: 2 sticks + Z + Rz + Rx + Ry + 4-bit hat + 32 buttons. Authoring deferred — no manufacturer-published 'design' separate from the descriptor.
